statement:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℝ),
  (starRingEnd ℂ) (∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, ↑(f x) * Complex.exp (-(↑n * ↑x * Complex.I))) =
    ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, ↑(f x) * Complex.exp (-(↑(-n) * ↑x * Complex.I))
